purpose: Qualify independently recomputable delivered-plan geometry after the v1 run exposed that bounded summaries alone were not independently auditable.

chronology.v1_disposition: retained partial instrumentation qualification; no rerun or replacement
chronology.correction: retain exact delivered plan poses in robot-visible DVC data and recompute every summary with a separately implemented evaluator

admission.recording_valid: fixture validity and exact runtime/source records pass; evaluator truth remains physically separate
admission.plan_geometry_present: at least one delivered plan retains all poses and a sha256 path identity
admission.independent_parity: the separate reference recomputes every retained plan hash, pose count, length, and signed/absolute deviation without a mismatch

allowed_conclusions: which global path geometries were delivered to the fixture and how they differed from the requested direct line
whether delivered plan geometry changed over the recorded action
delivered odometry trajectory and terminal action outcome
prohibited_conclusions: controller consumption of a delivered plan
a specific costmap or evaluator-only obstacle caused a plan change

analysis.statistical_status: one development instrumentation-qualification run; not pooled with the frozen legacy study and not held-out
